keyFindings.description: Security[secret]: guard.go:147 redactURL splits every URL flag at commas before parsing; pgx parses a -pg URL whole, so a comma in its password or password= parameter is part of the credential, and the split writes a fragment to meta.json (postgres://u:123,abc@h/db -> postgres://u:123,h/db; ?password=Abc,def123 -> ...,def123), which isURLList accepts. Regression from f93dbc53. Split at commas only for -nats; parse -pg and HTTP flags whole.
